verdict.rationale: Bitbucket docs explicitly describe managing Jira issues via a built-in Jira UI within Bitbucket, opening/creating Jira tickets from the PR screen, and automatic issue status updates from commits — directly matching the story of managing an external tracker (Jira) inside the code hosting UI. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of this specific Jira-in-Bitbucket UI (only vendor docs cited) and no mention of non-Jira external trackers.
